title: Baroque Report: CD Data File
native_title: バロック・レポート ＣＤデータ・ファイル
overview:
Baroque Report CD Data File is a free, not-for-sale preview disc for Baroque, Sting's first-person roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic world, where a nameless, amnesiac hero explores the randomly generated floors of a tower.

The disc is not a playable demo but an interactive collection of material about the game, browsed through menus with a short description for each entry:
- Full-screen movies, including an early version of the opening and a theatrical trailer
- Pre-rendered enemy models that can be rotated, plus concept art and in-game images of the monsters
- Artwork of the Neuro Tower and its surroundings, with a short movie of gameplay clips
- Photos of handmade models, character wallpapers, postcards and radio commercials
